studio._comment: The developer logo screen at startup. Letters, digits, space and - . ! & ' only.
studio.name: Pixel Pilots Studio

equipment._comment: Equipment slots shown in the inventory (the order here is the order on screen). Armor points reduce damage from falls by armorReduction each (starvation ignores armor).

tools._comment: wrongToolWear: how many uses a tool loses when it breaks a block it is not made for (a pickaxe on dirt, a shovel on stone); the right tool loses 1.

world._comment: tickCeiling: nothing ticks above this height (plants do not grow, water does not flow, sand does not fall): it is just somewhere to climb to.

breath._comment: Air under water: max points (2 per bubble), how fast it runs out and refills, and the damage once it is gone.

combat._comment: Hitting things. A weapon does weapons[type] + tierBonus[tier] damage (hand: handDamage); armor softens what monsters do to you. attackCooldown is the pause between hits.

xp._comment: Experience from monsters (for the armour and tool augments to come). Level n needs perLevel * n points on top of the last level.

sleep._comment: Sleeping in a bed flips day and night. A monster closer than monsterRadius stops you.

chests._comment: craftRange: crafting also uses the items in chests this close (blocks).
